prospective_scope.eligible_identity_rule: exercise each frozen 60 only with the one of these identities actually present in that 60
prospective_scope.component_change: permit the already-qualified public offered-spell counter-target ranking seam to accept Spell Pierce or Dispel in addition to Counterspell; do not change ranking
prospective_scope.whole_actor_change: route the current single cast offer for Spell Pierce or Dispel to the same offered-public-counter component
prospective_scope.real_engine_requirement: each case must use the actual registered card definition, actual legal target enumeration, actual canonical payment projection and a real opposing spell on the stack

required_cases: each Spell Pierce-containing frozen 60 casts real Spell Pierce at an actually offered opposing noncreature spell
the Dispel-containing frozen 60 casts real Dispel at an actually offered opposing instant spell
proposal target must be exactly the real offered stack spell entity
no hidden opponent hand or future library information is introduced
excluded: opponent Spell Pierce unless-pay-2 payment policy
ordinary priority scheduling beyond the exact current response window
multiple counter offers or ranking among multiple castable own cards
Snap, Sphinx's Approach, Artful Dodge, Deem Inferior, Lórien cycling or Sleep escape
whole-pilot, opponent package, collector, replay/durability or Stage-E admission
acceptance: Fresh source-bound real-engine targeted run passes every prospectively declared case. Acceptance is limited to current-cast receiving/routing and public offered-target selection for these two identities.
